node.label: ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 4 (Kufs type)
node.definition: A condition associated with mutation(s) in the DNAJC5 gene, encoding dnaJ homolog subfamily C member 5. The condition is one of a group of genetically heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorders, characterized by accumulation of intracellular lipopigments.
synonyms: ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 4 (Kufs type), autosomal dominant

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C5
